transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm just... having trouble talking, I guess. I can't keep my words in a straight line anymore. I'll start talking about, like, an overnight shift at work, and then... I don't know, I end up jumping to soccer, or paint colors, or patient charts. People get lost. I can see them getting lost. So I just... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been having any unusual thoughts or beliefs lately that others might find strange or hard to understand?

I don't know if they're strange. They're just... what's happening. The supervisors at work. They changed my shifts. I know they did it on purpose. They watch me through the cameras on the unit. They're waiting to see if I'm... unsafe. People keep telling me it's just staffing shortages, but... I know they're watching me.
Have you noticed if your thoughts feel like they're being put into your mind by someone else, taken out, or broadcasted to others?
No. No, I don't... it's just my own thoughts. They're just mine. Nobody's putting them there or... broadcasting them. I don't know what you mean by that, really. It's just the cameras.
Have you been hearing things that others don't hear, like voices or sounds, even when there's no one around?
No. I don't... I don't hear anything like that. Just regular sounds. People talking, machines... that's it.
Have you been acting in a way that others might find strange or disorganized, or have you had any episodes where you stopped moving or responding to people around you?

I don't know about strange. I just... sometimes I catch myself doing things. Like, I'll be in the hallway at work, and I'll realize I'm just... rocking back and forth. Or I'll see one of the patients tapping on a table, and I'll start copying them. I don't mean to. And sometimes... I'll just be standing there. I'll have one glove on, the other half pulled up, and I just... stop. Like I'm stuck. I know I'm supposed to be doing my rounds, but I just stand there.
Can you tell me more about the times you find yourself stuck or copying others? Does this happen often, and how long do these episodes last?
I don't really know. It just... happens sometimes. I don't time it. Just a few minutes, maybe. I don't know how often. Just... sometimes.
Do you ever find yourself staring blankly, unable to move, or in an odd posture without being aware of it or being able to control it?
I don't... I don't think so. I just told you about the getting stuck part. I don't know about odd postures. I just stand there.
Do you feel that you fully understand what's happening during those moments when you're stuck or copying others, or do you feel confused or unaware of why it's happening?
I don't really know. I just... I don't think about it much. It's just... confusing, I guess. I don't know why I do it. It just happens.
Can you describe any other times when you’ve felt physically stuck, moved without purpose, or copied someone else’s movements? Has this happened outside of work, or only in certain situations?

I don't really know about outside. Mostly just... at work. Sometimes I catch myself just... rocking in the hallway. Or if one of the patients is tapping on something, I'll start copying it. I don't know why. And... sometimes I know I'm supposed to be doing my rounds, but I just stand there. With my gloves only half on. Just... stuck like that.
Have you experienced episodes where you felt completely frozen, unable to move at all, or someone had to move you because you couldn’t respond?
I... no. No one's ever had to move me. I just... I told you, I just stand there sometimes. That's it.
Have there been times when you felt completely shut down, where it was hard to respond to things happening around you or you felt like you were moving in slow motion?

I guess... yeah. People have told me I move like I'm underwater sometimes. Just... slow. But then other times, it's the opposite. I can't sit still. I just pace around my apartment. Or I keep rubbing my hands together... until they get sore. It just depends.
Have you noticed a significant drop in how well you’re able to do your job or perform your regular duties at work compared to before these symptoms started?

Yeah... I guess so. At work, I've... I've needed the other orderlies to double-check my rounds. And my charting. I just... I can't keep track. 

And at home... I don't know. I haven't been paying my bills. I don't talk to my friends anymore. The apartment is just... it's a mess. 

It got pretty bad. Employee health... they sent me for an emergency eval. Because I... I told them I was thinking about... about suicide. So, yeah. Things have dropped off.
Have you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things you used to enjoy most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks at a time during this period?

Yeah... I guess. Most days, it's just... I just feel heavy. And empty. Right from when I wake up. 

After my shifts... I don't even go straight home. I usually just sit in my car in the lot. Sometimes I... I just sit there crying for a while before I can even drive back. It's just been like that.
Have there been times when you didn’t realize that your thoughts or actions, like copying others or getting stuck, were unusual or didn’t make sense?
I don't... I don't really know what you mean by that. I haven't noticed anything like copying people.
Have there been times in the past few weeks when you’ve felt like you’ve lost interest in just about everything, like nothing really matters or you don’t care about things you used to enjoy?

Yeah... I guess so. I just... I don't really care about much anymore. 

I used to do things. Sketch murals... cook for my friends... play soccer on the weekends. But... I don't know. It all just feels pointless now. I don't want to do any of it. 

I usually just... stay in my apartment. When people message me, I just ignore it. There's just no point.
Have you noticed that these episodes or feelings have started affecting your ability to take care of yourself at home, like keeping up with personal hygiene or daily chores?

Yeah... I guess. My apartment is... it's pretty out of control right now. I've fallen behind on all my bills. I just... ignore my friends when they reach out. 

It's not just at home, either. At work... I've needed my coworkers to double-check my rounds and my charting. I just can't... I don't know. It got bad enough that employee health got involved. They sent me for an emergency eval... after I admitted I was thinking about suicide. So... yeah. It's affecting things.
Have you had a period lasting at least a month where you've experienced ongoing difficulties like trouble working, social withdrawal, or symptoms such as disorganized speech or paranoid thoughts?
Yeah... it's been going on for a while. The... the feeling that people are watching me, and just... everything being a mess. It's been about a year... maybe a year and a month. Something like that.
